formulas.linear_pol_stokes_dop: S1=<|HH|^2>+<|VV|^2>, S2=<|HH|^2>-<|VV|^2>, S3=2Re(<HH*conj(VV)>), S4=-2Im(<HH*conj(VV)>), DOP=sqrt(S2^2+S3^2+S4^2)/S1, local mean over 5x5 px window
formulas.hybrid_pol_stokes_dop: LH=(HH+j*HV)/sqrt(2), LV=(VH+j*VV)/sqrt(2), then identical Stokes/DOP formula on (LH,LV)
formulas.eigenvalue_purity: k=[HH,HV,VH,VV] per pixel, C=(k^H k)/N over a tile, eig=eigvalsh(C) clipped>=0, p=eig/sum(eig), purity=sqrt(max(0,(4*sum(p^2)-1)/3))
formulas.source: Identical to src/candidate_dop_pipeline.py (primary candidate) -- not re-derived, only re-pointed at this candidate's covering acquisition.

best_supported_formulation: linear-pol (HH/VV) Stokes-covariance DOP -- same rationale as the primary candidate's DOP result.
calibration_applied: XML bias_real/bias_imag subtraction only (per-polarization, from this product's own PDS4 label). No gain-imbalance or phase-orthogonality correction applied -- same limitation as the primary candidate's DOP result.
channel_mapping_note: Level-1A SLI product with per-polarization TIF files explicitly named _hh_/_hv_/_vh_/_vv_ in the PDS4 label and filename -- ISRO-labeled directly, not byte-level-inferred.
limitations: Single acquisition, single ~2000x512 px window centered on the candidate -- not the full scene, not multi-temporal.
No independent ground-truth ice confirmation exists for this candidate anywhere in this project.
